sessionStart.command:
echo `# <#` > /dev/null
dir=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}
root=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$root" ] || { [ -d "$dir/.vendor/workflow-kit" ] && printf '%s\n' '{"additional_context":"Workflow Kit not checked: git did not find the project repository (is git on PATH?). From the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit"}'; exit 0; }
set -- $(git -C "$root" ls-files -s -- .vendor/workflow-kit 2>/dev/null)
[ "$1" = 160000 ] || exit 0
pin=$2
kit="$root/.vendor/workflow-kit"
ok() { [ "$(git -C "$kit" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = "$pin" ] && [ -f "$kit/AGENT_RULES.md" ]; }
ok && exit 0
if [ -e "$kit/.git" ] && { [ -n "$(git -C "$kit" status --porcelain --ignored --untracked-files=all 2>/dev/null)" ] || [ -n "$(git -C "$kit" rev-list -n 1 HEAD --not --remotes 2>/dev/null)" ]; }; then printf '%s\n' '{"additional_context":"Workflow Kit is not at the commit this project pins, but it has local changes or unpublished commits, so it was not updated: resolve them, then from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit"}'; exit 0; fi
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS=true SSH_ASKPASS=true git -C "$root" -c credential.interactive=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null submodule update --init --checkout .vendor/workflow-kit >/dev/null 2>&1
ok || printf '%s\n' '{"additional_context":"Workflow Kit missing, incomplete or not at the commit this project pins: from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit (still missing: git -C .vendor/workflow-kit checkout -- AGENT_RULES.md)"}'
exit #> > $null 2>&1
$dir = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { '.' }; $root = git -C $dir rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if (-not $root) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$dir/.vendor/workflow-kit" -PathType Container) { Write-Output '{"additional_context":"Workflow Kit not checked: git did not find the project repository (is git on PATH?). From the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit"}' }; exit 0 }; $out = git -C $root ls-files -s -- .vendor/workflow-kit; if (-not ($out -match '^160000')) { exit 0 }; $pin = ("$out" -split '\s+')[1]; $kit = "$root/.vendor/workflow-kit"; function Test-Kit { ((git -C $kit rev-parse HEAD 2>$null) -eq $pin) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$kit/AGENT_RULES.md" -PathType Leaf) }; if (Test-Kit) { exit 0 }; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath "$kit/.git") -and ((git -C $kit status --porcelain --ignored --untracked-files=all 2>$null) -or (git -C $kit rev-list -n 1 HEAD --not --remotes 2>$null))) { Write-Output '{"additional_context":"Workflow Kit is not at the commit this project pins, but it has local changes or unpublished commits, so it was not updated: resolve them, then from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit"}'; exit 0 }; $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'; $env:GIT_ASKPASS = 'true'; $env:SSH_ASKPASS = 'true'; git -C $root -c credential.interactive=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null submodule update --init --checkout .vendor/workflow-kit *> $null; if (-not (Test-Kit)) { Write-Output '{"additional_context":"Workflow Kit missing, incomplete or not at the commit this project pins: from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit (still missing: git -C .vendor/workflow-kit checkout -- AGENT_RULES.md)"}' }; exit 0

echo `# <#` > /dev/null
launcher="$HOME/.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.3-1/launch.sh"; if [ -f "$launcher" ]; then exec /bin/sh "$launcher" activate cursor; fi
printf '%s\n' '{"additional_context":"Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks."}'
exit #> > $null 2>&1
$launcher=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.3-1/launch.cmd'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher -PathType Leaf) { & $launcher activate cursor; if (-not $? -and -not $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 1 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output '{"additional_context":"Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks."}'
